reading: The sketch builds a cinema seat-selection screen: a 4-step progress stepper at top, a large white panel containing a skeleton bar, a "SCREEN" label, a 12x11 seat grid with an aisle gap and a legend row, and a separate right-hand booking-summary card with a poster placeholder, seat chips, price breakdown and a Continue button. All content and styling details come directly from the typed notes attached to each stroke group.
